name: Dagger of Venom
description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic dagger. Once per day, as an action, you can coat the blade in black poison for 1 minute; the next creature it hits must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution save or take 2d10 poison damage and be poisoned for 1 minute.

mastery.description: The extra attack granted by this weapon’s Light property doesn’t require a bonus action.
